caption: The drawing depicts an ornate iron stair railing that curves upward in the foreground, following the contour of a stone or concrete staircase. The railing features decorative scrollwork and circular motifs, and is supported by evenly spaced vertical balusters. At the top of the stairs, an upper landing is visible with additional railing and a tree growing next to it, its branches and leaves extending outward and filling the upper right portion of the image. In the background, architectural elements of a building can be seen, including walls, windows, and a section of roof. The image is rendered in black ink on a beige or off-white background, creating a monochromatic appearance with detailed hatching and line work to indicate shadows, textures, and depth. Toward the bottom left corner, the text "IRON STAIR RAILING" is written in all capital letters.
title: Iron Balcony
